BiblicalUsage: Shelesh was a son of Helem's brother, named in the genealogy of Asher: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal. One verse, one family, one tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Asher's genealogy is worth reading slowly. Shelesh is named among his brothers, and I hold that God counts the tribes man by man.
